plugins.name: cairn
plugins.description: Cairn — marks the trail and remembers the path. Self-contained: the GSD planning runtime ships INSIDE the plugin (no external gsd-core plugin is installed or required), and installing cairn bootstraps the beads issue tracker (bd); a single /cairn:init wires a project end to end, while /cairn:migrate wires repos that already have .planning/ or .beads/ history. The /cairn:* verbs drive the whole loop — plan, work, verify, ship — creating, claiming, closing and gating bd issues as they go. Optionally mirrors bd issues two-way (hub-and-spoke) to GitHub Issues, GitLab, Jira, Asana, and Azure Boards, and optionally makes the context-mode knowledge base intent-aware (scopes compressed memory to the active issue + phase). The integration conventions activate only in repos that use both GSD and beads.
